title_en: Supreme People's Court Releases Typical Cases of Crimes Infringing upon the Rights and Interests of Minors
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Releases Typical Cases of Crimes against Minors' Rights and Interests

Case 1

Bao — Rape and Child Molestation Case

——Using Teacher Status to Harm Students' Mental and Physical Health

(Basic Facts)

Defendant: Bao, male, Han ethnicity, born April 3, 1966, college education, primary school teacher.

In September 2010, the defendant Bao served as the head teacher or subject teacher for the female student victims Fang A (first victimized at age 9), Xu A (first victimized at age 10), Feng (first victimized at age 10), Xu B (first victimized at age 9), Fang B (first victimized at age 10), Zhan (first victimized at age 9), and Guo (first victimized at age 10) at a village primary school. From April 2009 to June 2011, Bao, using his status as a teacher, on the pretext of tutoring, cleaning, playing ping-pong, etc., successively lured Fang A, Xu A, Feng, Xu B, Fang B, Zhan, and Guo to the school's equipment room, office, and mimeograph room, etc., forced the seven female student victims to view obscene pictures and videos, and took the opportunity to touch the victims' chests and genitals, molesting each victim dozens of times in total; and also, by the same means, raped Fang A, Xu A, Feng, Xu B, Fang B, and Zhan dozens of times in total, and took nude photos or photos and videos of the six female student victims being raped. On September 19, 2011, after being reported, Bao, accompanied by the school principal and others, surrendered to the public security authorities and confessed most of the facts of molesting the female students.

(Judgment)

The court held that the defendant Bao raped female minors under the age of 14, constituting the crime of rape; molested female minors under the age of 14, constituting the crime of child molestation, and should be punished for both crimes concurrently. Bao, using his status as a teacher, over a period of more than two years, molested seven female minors dozens of times, raped six of them also dozens of times, and took nude photos and photos and videos of the six female minors being raped, severely disrupting the school's teaching order, greatly harming the students' physical and mental health, with extremely vile circumstances, extremely serious crimes, far-reaching effects, and great social harm, and should be punished according to law. After surrendering, Bao confessed the main crimes of molesting female minors; his crime of child molestation constituted voluntary surrender and could be given a lighter punishment, but his crime of rape did not constitute voluntary surrender and could not be given a lighter punishment according to law. Accordingly, the defendant Bao was convicted of the crime of rape and sentenced to death, with deprivation of political rights for life; convicted of the crime of child molestation and sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of five years, and the sentences were merged to execution of death, with deprivation of political rights for life. After review and approval by the Supreme People's Court, the criminal Bao was recently executed according to law.

Case 2

Li Yanqin Intentional Injury Case

——Step-mother Beating and Abusing Step-daughter under the Guise of "Education"

(Basic Facts)

Defendant: Li Yanqin, female, Han ethnicity, born April 5, 1983, middle school education, self-employed.

In September 2010, the defendant Li Yanqin and Shen Ergang, both divorced, began cohabiting as a couple. In February 2011, Shen Ergang's daughter Shen Xiaoran (victim, died at age 5) began living with Li Yanqin, Shen Ergang, and Li Yanqin's son Shen Yantong. During this period, Li Yanqin often beat Shen Xiaoran on the pretext that Shen Xiaoran did not do homework or was disobedient, using methods such as pinching, twisting, kicking, and scalding, causing injuries to Shen Xiaoran's head, face, neck, chest, abdomen, and limbs frequently. On March 27, 2012, Shen Ergang went to work elsewhere, and Li Yanqin took Shen Xiaoran and Shen Yantong to rent a house in Pingshun County, Shanxi Province to live together. On the evening of April 29, 2012, Li Yanqin beat Shen Xiaoran over trivial matters in her rented house, causing abdominal injuries, and later beat Shen Xiaoran's abdomen and other parts multiple times, aggravating the injuries. On the evening of May 4, 2012, Shen Xiaoran began to vomit, and Li Yanqin bought medicine for treating heatstroke and other symptoms for Shen Xiaoran to take. At about 17:00 on May 6, 2012, Shen Xiaoran and Shen Yantong were sleeping in the rented house, and Li Yanqin locked the two children inside. At about 19:00 that day, Li Yanqin returned home and found Shen Xiaoran lying under the bed, her body already cold. She then called 120 emergency and sent Shen Xiaoran to the hospital for rescue, but on the way, Shen Xiaoran died from infectious shock due to intestinal rupture caused by blunt force.

(Judgment)

The court held that the defendant Li Yanqin intentionally injured the victim Shen Xiaoran's body, causing her death, constituting the crime of intentional injury. Li Yanqin, under the guise of "education," during the period of cohabitation with Shen Xiaoran, frequently beat and abused Shen Xiaoran, ultimately beating her to death, with extremely vile circumstances, extremely serious crimes, and great social harm, and should be punished according to law. Given that Li Yanqin had the act of rescuing the victim, and after arrest truthfully confessed the main criminal facts, and had a good attitude of admitting guilt, she could be sentenced to death but not immediately executed. Accordingly, the defendant Li Yanqin was convicted of the crime of intentional injury and sentenced to death, with a two-year reprieve, with deprivation of political rights for life.

Case 3

Deng Jiawen Organizing Minors to Engage in Acts Violating Public Security Administration Case

——Organizing and Directing Minors to Enter Homes for Theft

(Basic Facts)

1. Facts regarding organizing minors to engage in acts violating public security administration

From August 2010 to February 2011, the defendant Deng Jiawen successively rented rooms at the Baoyuan Hotel, Longsheng Hotel, Yatai Hotel, Xingfu Hotel, and Huamei Hotel in Wengyuan County town to minors Yang, Lin, Zhang, Liu A, Li, Liu B, and Zhu B (among whom Yang, Zhang, and Liu A were 14 years old, Liu B and Zhu B were 15 years old, Lin was 13 years old, and Li was 12 years old), provided accommodation, food, and entertainment, and repeatedly organized and directed them to commit theft of property by climbing walls, kicking doors, prying doors, and picking locks to enter homes.

At about 19:00 on August 8, 2010, under the organization and direction of the defendant Deng Jiawen, Yang and Lin, by means of intimidation, forced Huang (12 years old) to take Yang to Huang's own home at No. 10, East Seven Lane, Qianjin Road, Wengyuan County. Yang stole RMB 200 in cash from the drawer in Huang's grandfather's room and a Jinpeng brand mobile phone (not appraised) belonging to Huang's fourth aunt. Later, Yang handed the cash and mobile phone to Deng Jiawen.

At about 10:00 on September 29, 2010, under the organization and direction of the defendant Deng Jiawen, Yang and Lin went to the home of Liu Meifeng in the County Construction Bureau compound on Chaoyang Road, Wengyuan County, climbed the wall to enter and stole a black Nikon brand camera (valued at RMB 1,200) and a bracelet (not appraised). Later, the two went to Room 205 of Longsheng Hotel and handed the stolen goods to Deng Jiawen.

At about 16:00 on January 6, 2011, under the organization and direction of the defendant Deng Jiawen, Zhang, Liu A, Zhu A, and Liu B went to the residence of He Meixia inside the Longxian Grain Depot on Education Road in the county town, kicked open the wooden door to enter and stole over RMB 200 in cash, a Panasonic camera, a Nokia, Samsung, and Haier mobile phone each, and cigarettes and other items, with the stolen goods totaling RMB 1,900 in value. Later, when He Meixia returned home, Zhang brandished a kitchen knife to intimidate He Meixia and fled the scene with the accomplices, handing the above items to Deng Jiawen.

At about 10:00 on January 12, 2011, under the organization and direction of the defendant Deng Jiawen, Zhang, Liu A, and others went to the home of Gan Zhaoming, Room 401, Building 4, No. 19 Jianshe No. 1 Road, Wengyuan County, pried open the door to enter and stole over RMB 2,900 in cash and an assembled computer (valued at RMB 2,500) and other items, later handing the above money and items to Deng Jiawen.

At about 15:00 on January 22, 2011, under the organization and direction of the defendant Deng Jiawen, Zhang, Liu A, Zhu B, and Li went to the home of Huang Bifa, Room 402, No. 36 Longying Road, Wengyuan County, pried open the door to enter and stole a Canon and a Sony digital camera each, a Philips and a Nokia mobile phone each, a Rolex watch, and a batch of liquor, tea, and other items, with the stolen goods totaling RMB 4,950 in value. Later, the tea and watch were handed to Deng Jiawen, while the liquor, cameras, and mobile phones were disposed of separately by Zhu B and Zhang.

2. Facts regarding extortion

One afternoon in February 2011, the defendant Deng Jiawen, together with Deng Minhong and Deng Qiusheng (both at large), at the entrance of Tianxin Primary School in Longxian Town, Wengyuan County, on the pretext that Liu Hua and Lai Chengfa had stolen large amounts of money and items without giving Deng Jiawen a share of the proceeds, used threats and coercion to forcibly extort a black Volkswagen Jetta car (worth RMB 20,000) used by Liu Hua, RMB 2,300 in cash, and a ring belonging to Lai Chengfa (not appraised).

(Judgment)

The defendant Deng Jiawen organized minors to commit theft, constituting the crime of organizing minors to engage in acts violating public security administration; with the purpose of illegal possession, he jointly with others used threats to forcibly extort property from others, constituting the crime of extortion, and should be punished for both crimes concurrently. Deng Jiawen repeatedly organized multiple minors to commit home burglaries, with serious circumstances; the crime of extortion involved a huge amount; all should be punished according to law. When Deng Jiawen organized Yang and others to steal property from Huang's home, he was under the age of 18, so he could be given a lighter punishment for this crime according to law. Accordingly, the defendant Deng Jiawen was convicted of the crime of organizing minors to engage in acts violating public security administration and sentenced to four years' imprisonment, with a fine of RMB 2,000; convicted of the crime of extortion and sentenced to three years and nine months' imprisonment, with a fine of RMB 2,000; the sentences were merged to execution of seven years and six months' imprisonment, with a fine of RMB 4,000.
